source.primary: Effective EC3 §12.5.6.6/Table 177, Table 166 and §12.7.4.3. Table177 defines a FreeText annotation and its variable/rich text inputs. Table166's AP requirement is a PDF 2.0 writer obligation for nondegenerate annotations; it does not convert a malformed widget classification into reader refusal duty.
source.fixture_distinction: The tested dictionaries are /Subtype /FreeText and appear in Page /Annots. Putting object 5 in Catalog AcroForm /Fields simultaneously treats that same annotation dictionary as a terminal form field. These tests intend standalone annotations, not Widget annotations.
